data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in the prior accident years 764 (223) 541
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2021 financial year, Syndicate 6132 experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 0.764 million in its claims outstanding provision related to prior accident years. This represents a 1.30% increase relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. The 2018 underwriting year was reinsured to close during 2020, which resulted in a significant reduction in claims outstanding for that year of account, but this is treated as an accounting transfer rather than a re-estimation of existing reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred in the prior accident years
data.data_quality_notes: The RITC (Reinsurance to Close) of the 2018 underwriting year externally in 2020 significantly impacts the overall claims outstanding and makes the claims development triangle unreliable for calculating total prior year development. The `prior_year_development_gbp_m` is taken from the 'Claims incurred in the prior accident years' line in Note 8, which represents re-estimation of prior year claims, but does not include the impact of the RITC transfer of -GBP 14.403 million.
